content:
marta: FYI — ticket #PRIV-4327: we scheduled the eu-west keystore decommission next week but the requester just filed a DSAR and a forensic hold came in. can we pause?
jamal: Ack. do we know if the embeddings snapshot includes subject data?
chris: It looks like one snapshot from 2023-10-02 might contain user-provided docs. not sure about embeddings extraction time.
legal-anna: If a DSAR + forensic hold are active, we need to stop any destructive ops until legal signs off. please preserve snapshots and provenance. :exclamation:
ryan: Agreed. also need an RBAC temporary grant for the privacy team to pull an immutable evidence bundle and to verify deletion proof. we should avoid granting broad keystore-decrypt keys.
marta: Proposal: pause decommission, create retention-exception ticket, and spin up a read-only evidence export role (scoped SA) for privacy + legal. chris/jamal can we add audit hooks to capture all keystore/KMS ops since 2023-09?
jamal: I can enable an audit-forwarder job to ship KMS and app-audit logs to secure S3 with write-once ACLs. will also snapshot current ACLs. command I'm planning: `gcloud logging sinks create priv-evidence-sink storage.googleapis.com/priv-evidence-bucket --log-filter="resource.type=kms_key OR protoPayload.serviceName:keystore"`
chris: For runtime, we should also freeze the erasure queue to prevent automated deletes. I'll flip the feature flag `erasure-queue.enabled=false` in staging then prod after signoff.
legal-anna: Please include timestamped proof of actions in the retention-exception so we can prove chain-of-custody. we need a short checklist in the ticket.
ryan: RBAC detail: create a new IAM role `roles/priv_evidence_reader` with only `storage.objects.get` and `logging.read` on the sink bucket and log views. no kms.decrypt. that way privacy can validate without exposing raw keys.
marta: Good. also: what's our plan for KMS rotation? if key rotates while hold is active we must ensure old key versions remain decryptable for evidence. jamal?
jamal: We'll disable automatic rotation for the key id `projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/keystore-eu` and snapshot key versions. do not destroy any key versions. I'll add a break-glass note.
ops-bot: [system] retention-exception created: PRIV-4327-EX (assigned to jamal).
marta: Action items: (1) jamal: enable sink + freeze rotation + snapshot ACLs (2) chris: pause erasure queue + preserve app snapshots (3) ryan: create scoped IAM role + review audit filters (4) legal-anna: confirm hold and escalation path. I'll hold decommission until PRIV-4327-EX closed.
chris: timeline — I can pause erasure and push snapshot artifacts within 2 hours.
jamal: sink up in ~30m, disabling rotation in ~10m. posting commands in the ticket.
ryan: I'll draft the role and post JSON IAM policy snippet for review.
legal-anna: Thanks. once we have preserved artifacts, I'll confirm the hold and share next steps with requester.
marta: Thanks team. keep updates in PRIV-4327 thread and tag me. :thumbsup:
